input_units.St: actuation Strouhal number, 0 labels greedy baseline
input_units.background_u: m/s; independent no-turbine uu at matched grid; linear x interpolation only at 4D

timing_contract: Fixed independent no-turbine background measurement and geometry/settings; no wake response input.
calibration: Independent no-turbine grids; x4D interpolates empty2D/5D, WT2 local+5D matches empty7D/9D. All new baselines have identical calibration.
independent_unit: whole control setting across turbines and downstream sections

reference.equation: u_hat = u_empty − (A+B I_turbine2) exp(−0.5[(y/sigma_y)^4+(z/sigma_z)^4])/(1+kx)^2; sigma_y=.35+kx, sigma_z=ell*sigma_y. Independent no-turbine background is declared calibration.

compact_candidate.equation: u_hat = u_empty − (A+B I_turbine2) exp(−0.5[(y/sigma_y)^4+(z/sigma_z)^4])/(1+kx)^2; sigma_y=.35+kx, sigma_z=ell*sigma_y. Independent no-turbine background is declared calibration.

background_gaussian.equation: yhat = offset + sum beta_j phi_j(inputs), with exact frozen terms/clocks in rules.json and run.py::design; clipping only for photovoltaic energy. Legacy model has exact original runtime/state.

uncertainty_policy.reason: Shared source system/people/materials, temporal dependence or small reserved-group counts do not justify precise population-level confidence. Group effects are descriptive; no row bootstrap.

scope_limits: Only four controls and one wind-tunnel system; three development controls and one reserved. Spatial errors describe field interpolation/transfer, not independent grid replicates.

exposure.historical_record: ALL original confirmation exposed; no fresh confirmation; diagnostics opened only after candidate/stopping freeze; all future evaluations are retrospective

historical_metric_corrections: F1 uses2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); zero on nonempty total failure. Historical reports unchanged.
